submitted.rationale: Every known Mg–Sb–O phase has a wide band gap, so EQE under 2.7 eV light is close to zero across the whole line. Of the five compositions measured, the Sb-rich end gave the highest EQE: index 28 (Sb 0.816) at 0.00127%, then index 26 (Sb 0.774) at 0.00115%. The signal was much lower in the middle and at the Mg-rich end. The trend rises toward the Sb-rich end, most likely because of Sb-oxide-like absorption at a slightly lower energy.
